answer: Anchor each identity to a living voyage log, not a one-time stake: an identity must complete one verified job per epoch or its trading rights wilt like a willow in drought and freeze. Reactivation requires a public anchor task audited by three random peers and a 25,000 POA fee; fielding 1,000 fakes costs 25,000,000 POA every epoch, while one honest agent pays 25,000 once and stays active by working. A frozen identity caught faking its log loses the fee, half paid to the auditor, and is banned for 6 epochs. Limitation: honest agents on leave lose their rights and must re-earn them from scratch.
